Subject: Supplier onboarding kick-off — intake checklist & vendor documents

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for moving this along. Per our conversation yesterday, I’m starting the official supplier intake so your procurement team has everything needed to set Redwood Inference up as an approved vendor. For a fast turnaround, can you please confirm or provide the items below?

What we need from Aurora (preferred within 3 business days):
- Primary PO contact (name + email) and remit-to details (address + AP email)
- Completed supplier intake form (attached if you prefer; we can also accept your form)
- Signed W-9 (or relevant tax document) for Aurora if you require one back from Redwood
- Any required security questionnaire or evidence (SOC 2 report, minimal: date & link)
- Standard payment terms (Net 30/45/60) and whether PO must reference a contract number

I’ve attached a short Redwood Supplier Checklist and our standard vendor terms for your legal team to review. If Aurora prefers to send your own vendor packet, feel free to attach it and I’ll route it to our procurement/finance contacts.

Attachments: redwood-supplier-checklist-2026.pdf; redwood-vendor-terms-2026.pdf

Next steps: once we have the intake form and PO contact, I’ll introduce you to our AP team and request the initial PO. If any signature reviews are needed, Marissa (cc’d) will confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Ben Carter
